title: Drone Dispatch
summary: Send a courier drone the right vector: the vector joining two points, a thrust of a given size, and a relay that divides a leg in a ratio.
subject: mathematics
concepts: A vector of given magnitude in a given direction
learningOutcome: The student can write the vector joining two points, scale a unit vector to a given size, and use the section formula for internal and external division.

levels.title: Point to point
levels.adds: Baseline: the vector from D to E is E − D, the end coordinates minus the start coordinates (Ex 10.2 Q1 to Q5; Example 4).
hints: Subtract the start from the end, x with x and y with y.
The order matters: end minus start.
Check by adding the vector to D: you should land on E.

levels.title: A thrust of the right size
levels.adds: New: the unit vector d/|d| times a size M gives a vector of size M along d (Ex 10.2 Q7 to Q10; Examples 6 to 8).
hints: Divide d by |d| to get the unit vector.
Multiply the unit vector by the size wanted.

levels.title: The relay
levels.adds: New: R divides PQ in the ratio m : n internally by R = (nP + mQ)/(m + n), and externally by R = (mQ − nP)/(m − n) (Ex 10.2 Q15, Q16; Misc Q8, Q9; Example 11).
hints: Internal division puts R between P and Q; external puts it outside.
Plug the coordinates into the formula one at a time.
For external division the denominator is m − n.

misconceptions: The vector from D to E is D − E
A vector of size M along d is M times d
External division uses m + n in the denominator
